transcript: Join me at the theater tonight! I'm seeing Disney's Lion King on Broadway. The Lion King is the first movie I ever saw in theaters at 4 years old, and it's been my favorite Disney movie ever since. So when Disney on Broadway invited me to see The Lion King at the Minskoff Theater, I was so excited. As soon as the opening notes of circle of life started, I immediately started to tear up. Watching all of the animals make their way towards Pride Rock is just breathtaking. It is Disney and Broadway magic at its finest. Lion King features so many of my favorite songs. I danced in my seat and I just can't wait to be king and gasped at the beauty of the staging of Can You Feel the Love Tonight. Just got home from seeing The Lion King on Broadway. It is so beautiful, so emotional, so funny. You'll just have the best time. Head to the link in my bio and buy tickets and experience this Disney magic for yourself. Go see The Lion King!
reasoning: Creator attended the show and delivers an enthusiastic, unreserved recommendation, praising the staging, emotion, and humor. Note: this is a sponsored/invited visit, which may inflate positivity.
